methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The scope of this paper is to identify the main internal and external factors that have an impact on the successful implementation of an energy management system in ports.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper applies a SWOT/PESTLE strategic-planning framework to identify internal and external factors affecting implementation of a port energy management system; energy baseline and energy performance indicators are mentioned only incidentally as generic ISO 50001 requirements, with no EnPI/EnB measurement model presented or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The method of collecting primary data for this study is through the use of structured interviews conducted with two leading North-European port authorities

stage1.notes: Application sector is maritime ports (outside the closed continuous-process list). ISO 50001 is used only as a guiding framework for the interview instrument; 'energy baseline' appears once as a conceptual SWOT factor, not a constructed model. paper_type multi-case (two port authorities) vs 'other' is a borderline call.
